title: 27 CFR § 478.39 - Assembly of semiautomatic rifles or shotguns
quote: No person shall assemble a semiautomatic rifle or any shotgun using more than 10 of the imported parts listed in paragraph (c) of this section if the assembled firearm is prohibited from importation under section 925(d)(3)
note: Reword the rule. The limit is on IMPORTED parts: no more than 10 of the 20 listed parts may be foreign-made. US-made replacements do not 'count toward the limit'; swapping one in lowers the imported-part count. The (c) list includes Buttstocks, Pistol grips, Forearms/handguards, Trigger housings, Triggers, Hammers, Sears, Disconnectors, Magazine bodies, Followers, Floorplates and Muzzle attachments. The rule applies only when the assembled rifle is a non-sporting configuration that could not be imported (e.g. pistol grip, folding stock, detachable large-capacity magazine). The ATF eRegulations page (regulations.atf.gov/478-39) was down, and eCFR redirected to a bot check, so I cited LII's copy of the CFR text.
